notes.title: The Sojourn: A Brand New Update for a Smoother Journey
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Long time no see. We just wanted to check in to let everybody know that we just released a brand-new update for The Sojourn.

We recently noticed that there were compatibility issues that stopped The Sojourn from running on Windows 11 in some instances. We’ve been working on a fix that’ll hopefully address those issues. We’re always dedicated to making our games as widely accessible as possible and we hope this fix will help future-proof and preserve The Sojourn for next-gen players.

On that note, we’re also currently tinkering with some other ways of bringing the game to new players; but more on that in the future.

notes.title: The Sojourn Steam release date reveal COMING SOON
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while! We're pleased to announce that the wait is almost over, and The Sojourn will be coming to Steam soon™

We'll be announcing the exact release date in the Iceberg Ahead show at Gamescom 2020 on August 29th. To be notified the moment it goes live, make sure you join the Iceberg Interactive Discord server!

We hope to see you there!
